rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing functions in prompts; scripted reactions cut
rules_evaluated.evidence: RE-FIRE, read in full including the Boundary clause: 'Past ten or so, you've become the agent; call it and read what's there' carries the exact 'or so' hedge, and matches the Boundary's own worked example verbatim ('a number that helps the student pace themselves ... when to stop nudging'). Harm §16 exists to prevent = body prose scripting a feeling/count that removes real judgment and that speed-runners skipping the body would miss anyway (moot here, since it's already body not fence). Harm here is absent: this is a fuzzy self-recognition threshold, not a bare imperative count, and a first-timer has no other way to calibrate nudge frequency -- cutting it would strip the one piece of calibration available. Maintainer carve-out is correct and is ACCEPTED; the earlier REVISE quoted the ban and stopped before the Boundary clause it sits inside.
